design.title: The trail behind every number
design.intro: SHUAMO is an instrument for creator performance: paper for calm reading, ink for certainty, and one electric signal for the next decision. This page keeps every component and every state visible before product screens begin.
design.provenanceQuestion: Where did this number come from?
design.provenanceAnswer: Open the aggregate. Read the rows. Follow the click to the order and the order to the exact commission.
design.rule.singleSignal: Single-Signal Rule — one indigo action owns a decision surface.
design.rule.equalScript: Equal-Script Rule — Georgian receives the same size, weight and room as English.
design.rule.moneyMono: Money-Is-Mono Rule — every GEL amount is exact, tabular and visibly signed.
design.rule.provenance: Provenance and Estimate Rules — aggregates open their rows; forecasts say estimate.
design.rule.stateWords: State-Needs-Words Rule — colour supports a written status and never replaces it.
design.rule.table: Money columns align by digit and overflow stays inside the table surface.
design.rule.feedback: A quiet state still explains what happened and what the user can do next.
design.rule.copy: Credentials remain legible, copyable and explicit when they can be revealed only once.
design.state.hover: Hover: the surface responds without shifting.
design.field.destinationError: Add a complete https:// URL so the buyer can reach the product.
design.status.greyscale: Every state remains readable in greyscale because every pill names itself.
